dedupe_keys.name: collection of practical examples of green infrastructure クリーンインフラ事例集 2021 edition

description: This 75-page collection presents completed green infrastructure projects as one-page case sheets, grouped into four sections: disaster prevention and mitigation, living space, urban space and ecosystem conservation. The planning and public relations committee of Japan's Green Infrastructure Public-Private Partnership Platform compiled it and published the March 2021 edition. Most cases are Japanese projects by municipalities, companies and citizen groups, and the introduction also cites foreign examples such as the High Line in New York, a climate adaptation square in Copenhagen and the Emscher restoration. Format and access: a single PDF in Japanese, free to download. Licence: not stated in the pages read. Caveats: cases are described by their proponents without a common set of measured outcomes, and the edition is from 2021. It helps find worked examples of flood retention, urban cooling and ecosystem projects in Japan for comparison and model setup. Related catalogue records are MLIT's green infrastructure portal and the Oppla nature-based solutions repository.
